original_target.title: Soliton resolution for bounded nonradial energy-critical waves

scope_comparison: The current June2026 primary abstract assumes compactly supported data and ground-state traveling waves with distinct velocities in a sequential decomposition. The local target permits arbitrary bounded nonradial strong solutions and requires decomposition along all times. Radial and sequential results do not supply this quantifier.
